✔ dedup gate refuses empty frames, missing tables and changed receipt/aggregate/archive data (0.255ms)

✔ fresh own MQTT session closes predecessor, disables reconnect and cannot touch a foreign device (0.410292ms)
✔ PUBACK has a bounded functional deadline, owns late rejection and never resubmits unknown publication (83.785458ms)
✔ cleanup never starts under unknown/running write ownership or retries an unknown cleanup Build (0.190791ms)
✔ only bounded fields are projected and an exact unique Job/source/SQS tuple proves production (0.817125ms)
✔ collector reads the exact fixed log group; truncation and repeated tokens cannot pass (0.323917ms)
✔ terminal Replay alone never releases cleanup; exact root and final consumer outcomes are required (0.143ms)
✔ only exact fresh suppressed identities and matching customer scopes are allowed (0.67325ms)
✔ real SQL seeds only INVITED and preserves outside users; duplicate seed never replays (634.624542ms)
✔ foreign customer and outside-user trigger mutation roll back all seed writes (403.684417ms)
✔ identity provisioning suppresses delivery, requires real returned subject, and cannot act on foreign names (0.843917ms)
✔ response rejection is owned even when the browser action fails first (0.545958ms)
✔ unknown fixture start is preserved and surfaced as a stop condition without replay (0.854834ms)
✔ cleanup recovery rejects foreign identities and sites before any AWS operation (279.362417ms)
